description: Grass spreading and sapling growth at dusk: their light checks (getMaxLocalRawBrightness >= 9) read the sky darkened by the day timeline (updateSkyBrightness before the block ticks), so once the sky darkening reaches 7 (day time 13015) grass blocks stop drawing their four spread positions from the level random and saplings stop rolling; under a roof of leaves (sky light 14) they stop earlier.
